name: Agalta
storyline: Ares is a young warrior who lives with his old parents in a secluded house on a peninsula. One day he goes to the nearby town, only to find our that four people were missing under mysterious circumstance. Ares decides to help and ventures to the nearby cave, which is said to harbor an evil power. That's where his adventure begins...
summary: A fairly traditional Japanese RPG developed by the doujin circle Fenrir with all the familiar ingredients of the JRPG genre, There is, however, a real-time element in the combat, similar to the ATB system of Final Fantasy series.
